Available tools:
- get_user_visited_venues: Get Foursquare data and enable user/merchant interactions.. Returns a list of all venues visited by the specified user, along with how many visits and when they were last there.
- get_route: Valhalla's routing service (a.k.a. turn-by-turn), is an open-source routing service that lets you integrate routing and navigation into a web or mobile application. See https://valhalla.readthedocs.io
I'd like to revisit a place I've been to before, so could you fetch my venue history using this access token: FSQ3H7J2K9L4M1N8 and then get me the route to the most recent one?

The tool successfully retrieved three previously visited venues with their locations and visit timestamps. Blue Bottle Coffee is identified as the most recent location based on the lastVisit value, so I will now calculate the route to that address.
